context: Decide whether to (a) update the command + README + validator to write drafts under the new protocol, or (b) revert/postpone the protocol flip until the capture path is migrated. Whichever is chosen, the command, docs/development/review-protocol.md, _project/blind-spots/README.md and the validator must agree in ONE commit so no window exists where an agent has contradictory mandatory instructions.
description:
chatgpt-codex-connector review finding on merged PR #1271 (P2, docs/development/review-protocol.md:131). Deferred from the PR-review sweep in PR #1292 as a coordinated governance change; tracked in GitHub issue #1293.

With the new drafts-only rule in place, any /blind-spot invocation now carries conflicting mandatory instructions: the command says to follow the protocol exactly, but still composes, writes, validates and reports _project/blind-spots/... (.claude/commands/blind-spot.md:14, :24-38). In the common path of using the slash command to capture a review finding, an agent must either violate the new 'only authorized write' invariant or be unable to complete the command.
Thread: https://github.com/joeharris76/BenchBox/pull/1271#discussion_r3634254553

Note (verified 2026-07-24): .claude/commands/blind-spot.md IS tracked and not gitignored, so it can be edited in the same PR. The blocker is the governance decision, not file access.

anti_patterns.dont: flip the protocol doc without updating the command and validator in the same commit
anti_patterns.why: that is precisely the contradictory-instruction window this item closes

preserves.behavior: Agents have exactly one non-contradictory capture path at every commit
An existing tracked blind-spot file still validates under the validator after the change

work_units.evidence: Decision recorded in commit 6df7e57bd: capture path stays drafts-only (~/.benchbox/finding-drafts, already implemented in the command); authority moves to docs/development/agent-review-protocol.md (REVIEW-CAPTURE-001 codifies the invariant); legacy doc demoted to non-authoritative historical rationale, not deleted
work_units.summary: Decide: migrate the /blind-spot capture path to drafts, or postpone the protocol invariant; record the decision

work_units.evidence: commit 6df7e57bd lands command + legacy doc demotion + blind-spots README + findings spec in one commit alongside audit/test surfaces; validator needed no change (no protocol references); check-scope flags only the companion item's files (documented same-commit exception per the item's own anti-pattern)
work_units.summary: Land command + review-protocol + blind-spots README + validator consistently in one commit

work_units.evidence: end-to-end capture: draft written to ~/.benchbox/finding-drafts, validate_blind_spot.py OK, artifact removed, no commit/push/tracker write during capture; tests 46/46 pass
work_units.summary: Confirm a /blind-spot capture completes end-to-end without violating the protocol
